properties.description:
Implement local contributor resolution and URL-based remote requests through both engines, with runtime peer discovery and no implicit whole-graph traversal. Keep authentication and disclosure at the receiving boundary. Verify one-to-many and many-to-one engines.

Implemented generic engine HTTP exchange and configurable browser transport contributors. Browser tests now connect one frontend to two explicit service URLs in shared and isolated modes; they verify no pre-request crawl, no forwarded local credentials, and retained acquisitions from both engines. Exact-origin CORS policy is opt-in at the receiving bridge. Engine and bridge focused tests pass; shutdown rejection and remaining consumer regression fixtures are being verified.

Slice verification completed: Generic engine transport, exact-origin admission, authentication and explicit runtime connections verified. Shared/isolated browser recordings cover two remote engines and prevent local credential forwarding; authenticated shutdown requests cannot invoke retired handlers.
properties.title: Route explicit requests through configured engine transports
